captions.instagram:
Class 11 Physics · Kinetic Theory
Physics, visualised #2 · Why does squeezing a gas raise its pressure? 🫧

A gas pushes on its container by hitting the walls. Halve the space and the same molecules, at the same speed, reach the piston twice as often: twice the hits → twice the pressure.
Halve it again → four times. Watch the counter: about 14 → 25 → 50 hits a second, and P × V stays 4 the whole way (Boyle's law). Plot P against 1/V and the curve becomes a straight line.

On your syllabus: Class 11 Kinetic Theory and Thermodynamics, JEE Main and MHT-CET ask Boyle's law every year.
